verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a local, UI-driven workflow: drop a reference on the home page, chat in the side panel, and follow progress in the Production line tab. There is no documented API or CLI for an external agent to submit a prompt, poll job status, or fetch the finished asset, and no cost reporting at all. The `post-video` CLI only publishes to social platforms, and the visible agent logs are UI features, so neither covers this programmatic loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost
